summary: Jan–Apr 2026 yield 6.93 t/ha (2,749.61 t), 18.5% above the same period of 2025 (Agro).
2025 yield 20.43 t/ha, 8% above the 18.90 budget and 37% above 2024's 14.88 (PA, Agro).
Crop recovery still suboptimal: 16.4 of 24 harvesting rounds in 2025, intervals around 19–20 days, only 1 Badang working (PA, Agro).
No manuring workers (0 of 3): 2025 manuring 74% complete and 2026 programme already behind, with 237.5 mt to apply by Oct (PA, Agro).
Pruning backlog: progressive pruning 0.34% in 2025, and P98B, P00C1, P01D and P06E still unpruned as of April 2026 (PA, Agro).

issues.title: Carry-forward of unfinished 2025 fertiliser conflicts
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 (5.3.2 and summary item 6): the manuring not completed in 2025 would NOT be carried forward. Agro 1/2026 (3.2): the estate was advised to skip only the final NK1 for P97A and carry forward the remaining Mixture B allocation to 2026.

issues.title: Corrective pruning % wrong in PA table
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Corrective Pruning Record: total 119.47 of 395.59 ha is shown as 67%, but it works out to 30.2%. P97/A2 at 20.41 of 78.24 ha is shown as 24%, but is 26.1%.

issues.title: Maintenance pruning programme does not add up
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Maintenance Pruning Record: the block programmes sum to 1,162.73 ha, not the stated total of 1,167.23. P98/B is shown as 163.89 ha, but 3 rounds x 56.13 ha = 168.39. P11/F shows 3.96 ha completed against 2.64 programmed, yet is listed as 100%.

issues.title: Circle spraying rounds misstated
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 5.1.1: 669.49 ha is called 0.6 rounds, but on 396.91 ha it is 1.7 rounds. The circle programme is 1,191.73 ha in the weeding table but 1,190.73 ha in the text.

issues.title: Planted area differs between reports
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 gives 396.91 ha (GPS). Agro 1/2026 yield tables use 399.2 ha total (P97/A2 79.6, P00/C2 91.5, P11/F 1.4) and its blocking table 986.5 ac. Yet the Agro 2025 yields (20.43 t/ha) match the PA figures computed on 396.91 ha.

issues.title: P98/B harvester earnings inconsistent
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 6.7.1: P98/B rate RM55/t x 1.66 t/manday = RM91.30, but average earnings are shown as RM82.96. That matches the RM50/t rate used for other blocks.

issues.title: Pest status assertion not backed by census
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 5.5.1 states 'no issues with rat infestations'. Agro 1/2026 4.5.1 says no pest censuses have been carried out since 2025, and the 21 barn owl boxes are unoccupied and all in poor condition.

issues.title: Harvester count differs by date
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table: 20 of 20 harvesters at Dec 2025 (adequate). The same report says 18 available in March 2026 (short 2), and recommends raising the requirement to 22 at a 1:18 ha ratio. Agro 1/2026 calls the workforce adequate with a minor shortfall.

actions.item: Recruit manuring workers (none employed); return sprayers to spraying
Recruit harvesters (short 2 as of March 2026; requirement 22 at 1:18 ha)
Apply about 47.5 mt/month to finish the 2026 fertiliser programme (237.5 mt) by October
Cut harvesting intervals to 15 days or less; set up a loose-fruit task force
Finish corrective pruning (276.12 ha balance) by June 2026, then progressive pruning
Expedite weeding in P97A1, P98B and P00C2; eradicate VOPs; rake circles in old plantings
Do quarterly pest censuses and restore the barn owl boxes (21 boxes in poor condition)
Run a GPS-mapped Ganoderma census and debole infected points
Desilt drains in P01/D and P06/E every year (machinery currently suspended over diesel price)
Apply EFB on sandy areas of P97/P00 for K deficiency
Repair the 2 broken Badangs or find an alternative to wheelbarrow evacuation
Fill the vacant office clerk post
Review manuring and spraying piece rates (earnings below RM65.38 basic wage)
Confirm P97 replanting (tentatively 2027) and prepare ahead

kb:
LADANG TANJUNG TUALANG (Lion Landscaping Sdn Bhd, Prosper group). Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok. Senior Manager Mr. T. Paramaswarn (a/l Thangavilu). Estate in charge En. Mohd Shahril Safuan Bin Yahya: Field Conductor in charge, promoted to Junior Assistant in charge from January 2026 (PA). Field Conductor Muppalinathan A/L Maniveloo. The Office Clerk post is vacant. Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng. Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming.
Sources: PA Report 1/2026 (visit 23 Apr 2026, reviews Jan-Dec 2025). Agronomy Report 1/2026 (visit 14 May 2026, previous visit 8 Nov 2025).

AREA (PA 1/2026, Dec 2025, GPS). All oil palm and all mature: 396.91 ha, plus a 0.81 ha building site, so 397.72 ha total. There is no immature area and no change in area.
New census 2025 (ha; old SPH to new SPH): P97/A1 99.06 ha (132 to 131); P97/A2 78.24 (134 to 133); P98/B 56.13 (131 to 129); P00/C1 49.29 (114 to 112); P00/C2 90.69 (127 to 125); P01/D 8.54 (122 to 120); P06/E 13.64 (131 to 129); P11/F 1.32 (136). Estate average 127 SPH.
Agro 1/2026 blocking table: 980 ac existing vs 986.5 ac surveyed by Garmin, averaging 52 SPA. Its yield tables use a 399.2 ha total.
Age (Agro): 57.2% of palms are over 25 years old and 39.2% are 20-25, so the estate is in descending yield. P97 (29 years) is tentatively to be replanted in 2027 but this is not finalised. The PA report says there is no decision on replanting.

LABOUR (PA, Dec 2025), requirement vs actual: harvesters 20/20; pruners 4/5; drivers 3/3; weeding 3/3; manuring 3/0. Total 33 vs 31. Harvesters were 18 in March 2026 (short 2). The PA advises a 1:18 ha ratio, so 22 harvesters, because only 1 Badang works and the others use wheelbarrows. Sprayers are temporarily deployed to manuring. Worker ratio 1:12.8 ha. Basic wage RM65.38-65.39 per day.

UPKEEP 2025 (PA).
Circle spraying: 669.49 of 1,190.73 ha (56%), behind because sprayers were moved to manuring. Output 3.3 ha/manday (5 is possible) at RM16/ha, earning RM52.80/day, which is below the basic wage. Glyphosate 0.63 L/ha plus Ally 0.02 kg/ha; Ally is not needed. Circle raking is needed in the old plantings.
Selective spraying: 396.91 of 1,190 ha (33%, 1 of 3 rounds). Inter-rows are Nephrolepis dominant with abundant VOPs, so prioritise VOP eradication. Output 3.7 ha/manday (7-8 is possible) at RM17/ha, earning RM62.90/day. Garlon 0.54 L/ha plus Ally; 8 pumps/day suggests about 5 working hours.
Manuring: 23 of 31 rounds (74%). The September to November rounds were not applied (NK1 for P97 A1/A2 and P98 B; MIX B for C1, C2, D, E, F). Wheelbarrow output 27 bags/manday at RM2.30/bag, earning RM62.10/day; consider revising the rate.
Pruning: progressive 3.96 of 1,167.23 ha (0.34%), with only P11/F done. Corrective pruning: 119.47 of 395.59 ha (the table says 67%; actually 30%). P97/A1 is done and P97/A2 has 20.41 ha done. The 276.12 ha balance is due by June 2026, with 4 pruners engaged since July 2025. Costs: progressive RM1.20/palm/year; corrective RM2.30/palm.
Pests and diseases: bagworm trunk injection in April 2025 (P00/C2 9.24 ha, 1,155 palms; P11/F 1.32 ha, 175 palms). No new attacks. PA says no rat issues. Sporadic Ganoderma (P98/B, P00/C1, P97/A1); debole fallen palms. Stray cattle carry bagworms.
Roads: no grading of the 847.94 chains budgeted (RM12.50/chain), which is not needed. 500 of 500 t crusher run bought at RM31/t actual vs RM28 budget. Roads are passable.
Drains: 177.9 chains of 6x4x2 at RM72 and 248.8 chains of 8x6x4 at RM85 desilted, not budgeted. P06/E and P01/D main and field drains need desilting, but heavy machinery work is suspended due to the diesel price.

CROP (PA and Agro). 2025 production 8,108.08 t vs 5,906.69 t in 2024.
Block yields in t/ha, 2024 to 2025: P97/A1 10.10 to 20.01; P97/A2 13.42 to 21.30; P98/B 20.75 to 22.60; P00/C1 16.22 to 20.92; P00/C2 18.49 to 19.95; P01/D 9.18 to 18.08; P06/E 6.77 to 11.21; P11/F 33.07 to 32.34. Total 14.88 to 20.43 (+37%).
The budget was 18.90 t/ha, so 8% above. Harvesting rounds were 16.4 vs 24, the average interval was 19 days and harvester outturn was 81%. 1 Badang is working and 2 are broken (the contractor cannot afford repairs).
Harvesting rates: RM60/t for 1997, RM55 for 1998 and RM50 for the others. Output 1.51-1.77 t/manday, with earnings RM75-99. Manual loading at RM9/t.
Bunch weights, Dec 2024 to Dec 2025: 1997 16.99 to 26.20 kg; 1998 19.59 to 31.34; 2000 22.92 to 27.26; 2001 18.55 to 26.87; 2006 10.88 to 17.64; 2011 15.62 to 24.06. The low 2024 weights reflect harvester shortage.
Agro: the 2025 gain came from completing the full 2024 fertiliser programme and better crop recovery. Crop recovery was still only about 60% of target in most fields. P06 is below potential due to high water tables.
Yield history (Agro Appendix 2), t/ha: 2021 12.48, 2022 13.63, 2023 20.80, 2024 14.88, 2025 20.43.
Monthly 2026 production (Agro): Jan 754.67, Feb 588.09, Mar 652.02, Apr 754.83, totalling 2,749.61 t.
Jan-Apr yield (Agro Table 8), 2025 to 2026 in t/ha: P97/A1 3.88 to 6.73 (+73.5%); A2 7.00 to 7.05; P98/B 7.60 to 6.92 (-8.9%); C1 7.00 to 8.12; C2 5.96 to 7.03; P01/D 4.02 to 4.78; P06/E 2.49 to 3.85; P11/F 8.61 to 8.74. Total 5.85 to 6.93 (+18.5%).
Harvesting intervals Jan-Apr 2026, in days: A1 12-19, A2 16-26, P98 22-34, C1 14-27, C2 15-25, P01 14-23, P06 13-28, P11 12-19. The target is 15 days or less. Over-ripe bunches were seen on P97A1 platforms, and loose fruit collection was poor where circles are weedy. Most harvesters produce under 2 t/manday.

AGRONOMY 2026 FIELD STATUS (Agro).
Manuring: no workers assigned. Behind schedule: P00C2 NK1 (Jan); P01D, P06E and P11F MIX B (Feb); P00C1 and P00C2 MIX B (Apr). The balance is 237.5 mt, so the estate needs 47.5 mt/month to finish by October 2026. Delivery and storage are fine.
Palms: P01/P06 flood-prone with weak vigour and mild chlorosis; continue desilting and palm mounding yearly. Mild K deficiency on sandy P97/P00, so apply EFB.
Pruning: P97A is largely done, P00C2 about 80% and P11F is up to date. No pruning in P98B, P00C1, P01D or P06E because of harvester/pruner turnover and flooding.
Weeding (Apr 2026): inter-row round 1 done in A1, C2 and F (48% overall); circle round 1 done in A2, B, C1, D and E (52%). Circles are overgrown in A1 and C2 (Ageratum, VOPs). Nephrolepis is encroaching into circles. Weeding can stay deferred in P01/P06.
Pests: no census since 2025 and the barn owl project is neglected (21 boxes, all poor, none occupied). Ganoderma in P97, P98 and P00: do a GPS census in 5 categories, debole 1.5 m cube, and no mounding.

FERTILISER 2026 (Agro Appendix 1, revised for high fertiliser prices and limited stock), g per palm:
P97A1/A2: NK1 2000 Jan; NK1 1500 May (withdraw if replanting).
P98B: NK1 2500 Feb and Jun.
P00C1/C2: NK1 2000 Jan, MIX B 1500 Apr, MIX B 2000 Aug.
P01D: MIX B 2000 Feb, 1750 Apr, 1500 Jul and Sep.
P06E: as P01D plus RP 1500 Jun.
P11F: MIX B 2500 Feb and May, RP 1500 Jun, MIX B 1500 Aug and Nov.
The 2027 programme comes after the second visit in H2 2026.

RAINFALL (Agro Appendix 3), mm and rain days: 2021 2,785 (146); 2022 2,759 (139); 2023 3,522 (170); 2024 3,792 (165); 2025 2,931 (157).

DATA ISSUES: The reports conflict on carrying forward the unfinished 2025 fertiliser. The PA corrective pruning % is wrong (67% stated vs 30% actual). The PA maintenance pruning total is off and the P98 programme figure is wrong. The PA circle rounds are misstated (0.6 vs 1.7). The reports use different planted areas (396.91 vs 399.2 ha). P98/B harvester earnings do not match its rate. The PA reports no rat issue although no census has been done.
